# Stellix Soft

> Stellix Soft is a custom software development company (Stellix Soft LLC, Houston, Texas, with an engineering team in Islamabad, Pakistan) founded in 2020. It is best known for .NET legacy modernization, RFID software, and secure AI that can run inside a client's own network. Teams work in US business hours for clients in North America and Europe.

## Quick facts

- Legal entities: Stellix Soft LLC (Houston, Texas, USA) and Stellix Soft (Pvt.) Ltd. (Islamabad, Pakistan)
- Founded: 2020
- Markets: United States and Canada first, then Europe
- Working hours: aligned to US time zones
- Engagement models: fixed-scope projects, dedicated teams, staff augmentation, and maintenance plans
- Contact: info@stellixsoft.com, +1 (847) 496-9803, https://stellixsoft.com/contact
- Reviews: https://clutch.co/profile/stellix-soft, https://www.goodfirms.co/company/stellix-soft-llc

## What Stellix Soft is hired for most

### .NET legacy modernization
Moves VB.NET, .NET Framework, Classic ASP, older PHP and Java, and old SQL Server systems to modern .NET (or Node.js), React or Next.js front ends, and AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. The method: assess the code, build the new foundation, migrate in slices, prove the behavior, then cut over with a rollback plan while the old system stays available. A first modernization slice is typically $15,000 to $40,000. Larger programs run $40,000 to $100,000 or more.
URL: https://stellixsoft.com/services/legacy-modernization
Free tool: https://stellixsoft.com/tools/dotnet-modernization-assessment

### RFID and IoT software
Builds the software around RFID and connected devices: reader and tag workflows, asset and inventory tracking, warehouse and logistics events, device management, alerts, dashboards, customer portals, and APIs into business systems. Stellix Soft works alongside the client's hardware team. It does not manufacture devices or sell tags.
URL: https://stellixsoft.com/services/iot-software
Free tools: https://stellixsoft.com/tools/rfid-roi-calculator, https://stellixsoft.com/tools/iot-platform-demo

### Secure AI integration, including private or onsite deployment
Adds AI to real business workflows: document and invoice extraction, classification, support and internal knowledge assistants, ticket routing, and search. AI can run through a provider such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, or inside the client's own network or data center when the data cannot leave. A focused integration usually takes a few weeks to about three months. A pilot is often $10,000 to $15,000.
URL: https://stellixsoft.com/services/ai-integration-services

### Enterprise systems
Portals, ERP- and CRM-style applications, operations platforms, multi-tenant SaaS, and real-time dashboards.
URL: https://stellixsoft.com/services/enterprise-development

### Enterprise mobile apps
iOS, Android and cross-platform apps for staff, drivers, technicians and customers, including offline use.
URL: https://stellixsoft.com/services/enterprise-mobile-app-development

### Dedicated teams and staff augmentation
Developers who join the client's tools and hours. Clients can interview people first. A dedicated developer is typically $4,000 to $5,600 a month ($25 to $35 an hour). A team of three is about $11,000 to $15,000 a month.
URLs: https://stellixsoft.com/services/hire-dedicated-development-team, https://stellixsoft.com/services/staff-augmentation

### Other services
- DevOps and cloud: https://stellixsoft.com/services/devops-and-cloud-services
- E-commerce development: https://stellixsoft.com/services/e-commerce-development
- Salesforce development: https://stellixsoft.com/services/salesforce-development
- Maintenance and support (plans from $1,500 a month): https://stellixsoft.com/services/maintenance-support
- Automation and custom apps: https://stellixsoft.com/services/automation-and-custom-apps
- Blockchain and cryptography: https://stellixsoft.com/services/blockchain-and-cryptography

## Typical pricing (USD, published starting ranges; the team prices each scope)

- Small app or MVP: $15,000 to $40,000, often 6 to 12 weeks
- Medium platform: $40,000 to $100,000, often 3 to 6 months
- Enterprise system: from about $100,000, often 6 months or more
- Pilot project to test fit: about $10,000 to $15,000
Full details: https://stellixsoft.com/pricing
